notes.title: Cats & Cups Demo – Patch Notes v0.8.2
notes.notes:
Your café just got a little cozier! This update focuses on fixing bugs, polishing mini-games, and making your kitty café smoother to run.  

[b]✨ New & Improved[/b]  
- Added [b]Blender machine[/b] (unlockable in demo)  
- Upgraded [b]Bakery & Oven animations[/b] (mini oven, dough cutting, croissant baking)  
- [b]Milk & Coffee machines[/b] now have proper refill systems with warning pop-ups  
- New [b]supply manager[/b] system to better track your stock  
- Tutorial updates: skip main tutorial option + smoother progression  
- [b]Tooltip updates[/b] for ingredient shop and upgrades  
- [b]Recipe papers[/b] improved with clearer glow & customer indicators  
- [b]New SFX[/b]: grinder, whipped cream, coins, oven, and more for extra café vibes  
- Journal drawer & recipe journal UI refinements  

[b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b]  
- Fixed [b]ingredient & trashcan glitches[/b]  
- Resolved [b]blender cup index bug[/b]  
- Coffee grinder mini-game bugfixes & animation tweaks  
- Fixed [b]supply popup warnings[/b] and start supply issues  
- Espresso machine glow + collider fixes  
- Water & straw machine button collider fixes  
- Fixed [b]cup stacking visuals[/b] and tooltip overlaps  
- Several tutorial bugs resolved (glitched steps, TV loops)  

[b]🍵 Balancing & Quality of Life[/b]  
- Drink limit raised: 5 → 10 per stack  
- Clearer [b]low supply warnings[/b] at day end  
- Adjusted [b]cup prices & amounts[/b] for smoother early game flow  
- Improved [b]machine upgrade UI & tooltips[/b]  
- Camera control tweaks for bakery/shop scenes  

That’s all for this update — thank you for playing and sharing feedback! 💌  
If you tried the demo earlier, give it another go — things should feel smoother and more balanced now. ☕🐱

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521410/Cats__Cups/
